parameters.query:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode($1,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb AS j
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id, source, event, video, payload, session_id)
  SELECT j->>'lead_id', 'landing', j->>'event', (j->>'video')::int,
         jsonb_build_object('watched_seconds',  (j->>'watched_seconds')::numeric,
                            'position_seconds', (j->>'position_seconds')::numeric,
                            'route',            j->>'route',
                            'client_ts',        j->>'client_ts'),
         j->>'session_id'
  FROM e WHERE j->>'event' <> 'heartbeat'
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
), hb AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_heartbeats (lead_id, session_id)
  SELECT j->>'lead_id', COALESCE(j->>'session_id','unknown')
  FROM e WHERE j->>'event' = 'heartbeat'
  RETURNING 1
), upd AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    score_intent    = LEAST(20, score_intent + CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins)
                                                    THEN COALESCE((SELECT (j->>'score')::int FROM e),0)
                                                    ELSE 0 END),
    resume_position = GREATEST(resume_position, COALESCE((SELECT (j->>'resume')::int FROM e),0)),
    -- Derived server-side from the recorded milestone, never taken from the
    -- client. The middle term covers the video_90 arriving in THIS statement,
    -- which the EXISTS below cannot see (CTEs read the pre-statement snapshot).
    video5_unlocked = video5_unlocked
                      OR COALESCE((SELECT j->>'event'='video_90' AND (j->>'video')::int=4 FROM e), false)
                      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_events x
                                 WHERE x.lead_id=(SELECT j->>'lead_id' FROM e)
                                   AND x.event='video_90' AND x.video=4),
    next_action_at  = COALESCE((SELECT (j->>'next_action_at')::timestamptz FROM e), next_action_at),
    followup_step   = CASE WHEN (SELECT j->>'seq' FROM e) IS NOT NULL
                            AND followup_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT j->>'seq' FROM e)
                           THEN 0 ELSE followup_step END,
    followup_sequence = COALESCE((SELECT j->>'seq' FROM e), followup_sequence)
  WHERE lead_id = (SELECT j->>'lead_id' FROM e)
  RETURNING 1
), capi AS (
  INSERT INTO capi_queue (lead_id, stage)
  SELECT j->>'lead_id', j->>'capi_stage' FROM e
  WHERE j->>'capi_stage' IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)  AS inserted,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM hb)   AS heartbeats,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd)  AS lead_updated,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM capi) AS capi_queued;
